Gravity retaining wall, per metre length. The cross-section is a rectangle (top width x wall height) plus a triangle that makes up the rest of the base width. The front face (toe side) is vertical and the back face is battered, so the triangle is on the back (heel) side with its apex at the heel. Concrete unit weight 24 kN/m3. Rankine active earth pressure acts horizontally on a vertical plane through the back of the base: Pa = Ka * gamma_s * H^2 / 2. Ignore the weight of soil over the battered face, passive pressure, water and surcharge. FS_overturning = resisting moments / overturning moments, both about the toe.
